faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: 130+ carrier appointments across Life, Health and Supplementary — national and regional. The list grows as we add appointments.
faq.q2: Do you own my book of business?
faq.a2: No. You keep 100% ownership of your book from day one. Epicare is your operating infrastructure, not the owner of your work.
faq.q3: How much does the platform cost?
faq.a3: GO AMS, GO CRM, Eppigo™ and Academy are included in your producer contract, with no platform fee. The only thing agreed at contracting is your commission split.
faq.q4: Do I need to be in Florida?
faq.a4: No. We are headquartered in Miami, but we operate across all 52 jurisdictions: the 50 states, Washington DC and Puerto Rico. You sell wherever you are licensed.
faq.q5: Is Epicare a startup or an established company?
faq.a5: Epicare Insurance Corp has been operating since 2021, with 6,000+ insured members and 100+ active agents. EIN 87-1093490 · NPN 19985316 · EPICARE® registered with the USPTO (Reg. 8148738).
faq.q6: What if I already have my own CRM?
faq.a6: Keep using it. GO AMS is where your contracts, commissions and licensing live — that does not get duplicated in another system. Your data is exportable whenever you need it.
faq.q7: How long does full onboarding take?
faq.a7: 24 to 48 hours from signing if your licenses are active. Carrier appointments depend on each carrier turnaround; you track the live status from the portal.

faq.q1: How much does GO AMS cost?

faq.q3: Can I quote with all 130+ carriers?

faq.q4: What happens to my existing book of business?

problem.h2: A sale doesn't happen in one step.
problem.p1: Someone called on Tuesday asking about a plan. It stayed in the phone history.
problem.p2: You sent the quote via email. It's still there.
problem.p3: They said they were thinking about it, to write back in two weeks. That stayed in your head.
problem.p4: They sent their documents via WhatsApp on Friday. They got lost among other chats.

salesLayer.title: With a <blue>CRM</blue> you turn loose opportunities into <blue>predictable sales</blue>.
salesLayer.p1: Each one has a value and they can all fall through for the same reason: nobody called back.
salesLayer.p2: That's what a CRM does. Each person gets a file, their stage is tracked, and the next step is planned. It moves out of your memory and into a system.
salesLayer.cierre: GO CRM manages the income you haven't collected yet.
salesLayer.disclaimer: It doesn't quote, issue policies, or manage commissions. You already have other tools for that.
salesLayer.feature1Desc: A file for every person who hasn't bought yet: their details, what they need, and their current stage. Contacted, quoted, application sent, waiting for docs, closed. Grouping them by stage shows you exactly where your business is stalling.
salesLayer.feature2Desc: Something you owe someone, with a deadline. Call Maria on Thursday. Ask Carlos for his ID. This is what turns a contact book into a work plan.
salesLayer.feature3Desc: Rules the system executes for you. A prospect comes in, the welcome email goes out. Three days pass with no response, a callback task appears. You set the rules.
salesLayer.feature4Desc: Everything that happened with that person, recorded. And no prospect is left without a defined next step.

hero.subhead: We build the infrastructure, brand, technology, and operations that help independent agents compete and win.

mission.title: We exist to build the infrastructure, brand, technology, and operations, that lets independent agents compete and win across the United States.
mission.body:
The market rewards big agencies.
We bet the independent agent, with the right tools, delivers the best experience for the end client.

vision.title: We're headed to be the reference agency in the United States, where the independent agent has everything they need to grow.
vision.body: We grow when the agent grows. Tools, training, brand, compliance, and commissions, all in one place, so no one has to choose between scaling and doing it right.

items.title: The problem
items.body: Insurance has always had a door, and not everyone gets the key. Jargon, small print, layers of middlemen. For an independent agent, that means competing against agencies many times their size, with fewer carriers, fewer tools and no marketing team behind them. For the client, it means coverage often depends on knowing someone, or speaking the right language. The market rewards big agencies. We didn't think it had to stay that way.

items.title: The decision
items.body: In June 2021, Epicare Insurance Corp started operating as a licensed insurance agency in Miami, Florida. The bet was simple: give the independent agent what only big agencies had. Technology that replaces a scattered stack. Marketing in English and Spanish that brings qualified leads. And industry support: carriers, contracting, compliance and training, with an expert team behind every case. Not as separate services, but as one foundation to build a book of business on, on the agent's terms.

items.title: The foundation
items.body: Today we serve all 50 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico, with 130+ active carriers and a trademark registered with the USPTO. What started as one agency is now one system of five books: Insurance Corp, Plans, B2C Verticals, Epicare GO and Academy. Each has its own audience. All share the same standard. And the rule hasn't changed: we back the agent, we don't compete with them. We keep building.

structure.title: We've spent years putting every piece to the test: top-tier carriers, the best team, the strongest markets, and plans built around every client's budget.

items.text: Every metric, every operation, and every risk is visible. We don't hide behind complexity. Our platform brings immediate transparency to every layer of your business.
You govern the platform, the platform doesn't govern you. We build systems that adapt to your protocols, ensuring your strategic decisions translate instantly into operational reality.
Trust holds because it can be verified. Our infrastructure guarantees 99.99% uptime, uncompromising security, and mathematical certainty in every transaction.
